items.title: 52.0% on Gemma-4-31B
items.summary: Declarative Attention proposes letting the model declare where to read in long context, reducing attended tokens during decoding by 52.0% on Gemma-4-31B and 31.1% on Qwen-3.6-27B on 15 tasks, summarized by @omarsar0

items.subsection: Benchmarks, Eval Infrastructure, and Research Methods
items.summary: Trace-as-State shows large long-context gains by putting prior reasoning before the source context on a second pass, e.g. DeepSeek V4 Pro Preview from 29.2% → 81.8% and GLM-5.2 from 66.4% → 100% on GraphWalks Parents via @dair_ai

items.title: Dyson made a $499 AI toothbrush
items.summary: the CameraJet has a tiny camera in the brush head that takes 28 images a second, uses on-device AI trained on 470K dental images to spot the gaps between your teeth, then shoots mouthrinse into them within 100 milliseconds.

items.title: Perplexity runs a model locally on your Mac
items.summary: a new Hybrid Mode will let Computer use models running directly on your Mac for some tasks, while still using cloud models for the harder stuff. The local steps don’t use Computer credits and the data involved stays on your machine.

items.title: Meta says its models are finally catching up
items.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 is Meta’s new best model, with a big jump in coding and agentic stuff. Alexandr Wang says it’s competitive with Claude Fable 5.1, better than GPT-5.6 Sol (especially at coding) and better than any of the current open-source models.

items.title: Gemini can now decide which bits of a video it actually needs to watch
items.summary: Google added “agentic” video understanding to Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite. Instead of processing a whole video at a fixed frame rate, Gemini can jump around between different moments, frames, audio and transcripts, then go back and look clos…

items.title: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1
items.summary: they’re actually the same underlying model , but Fable is available to everyone while Mythos has fewer safeguards for cybersecurity and biology and is only available to vetted organizations. ( read the announcement )

items.title: World Labs has a new world model called Atlas
items.summary: it can take images, video and camera movements and turn them into a 3D world you can move around in. You can basically give it a few photos, tell the camera where to go and generate new image/video frames from that exact viewpoint.

items.title: Meta has a new real-time speech model
items.summary: Muse Voice Transcribe is Meta’s first real-time audio perception model. It does speech-to-text, figures out who’s speaking and knows when someone has stopped talking, all in one model.
